# Proposed pickup directive (measurement fixture, not installed)

Bind the exact issue and check its state, branch, worktree, dependencies, and current estimate. For Plan-or-later pickup, post the deep dive and stamp `Deep dive complete` before source edits. [pickup.deep-dive] Reassess size and stop at mandatory decomposition thresholds.

Run each declared verification command in Develop or Test. Verify each demonstrable AC and functional DoD item individually with exact-head evidence and root `vc:N` citations; never bulk-check. [pickup.per-ac] Review reuses receipts and refuses stale evidence. Report the role-specific terminal status and keep the parent epic's child ordering.

Bootstrap fail-closed: stop and report the failed step before source edits. [pickup.bootstrap] An epic waits for every child to reach Review before ticking epic AC or DoD boxes. [pickup.epic] Re-read the latest conversation before a state move or active-issue switch. [pickup.checkpoint] On a mistake, stop, describe it, and wait for direction. [pickup.mistake] Use the sanctioned issue-body operation; never hand-roll a GitHub body replacement. [pickup.body] A child agent reports `CODE_COMPLETE`; the orchestrator owns Review and close. [pickup.agent-terminal]
